title: ConMoE: MoE Compression as Expert Selection and Functional Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2605.29350v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity through sparse activation, but storing their full parameters remains costly in GPU memory. Existing expert compression methods address this problem through pruning, merging, or substitution, typically coupling expert pool construction with the assignment of routed workloads. In this work, we formulate expert compression as two decisions--constructing an expert pool and assigning the original experts' workloads to that pool--and show that assignment can be optimized after the pool is fixed. Based on this formulation, we introduce ConMoE, which constructs a compact pool using Anchor Coverage and optimizes assignment through a router-conditioned functional objective derived from a layer reconstruction bound, treating parameter proximity only as a proxy. translated_title: ConMoE：将MoE压缩视为专家选择与功能分配
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家模型通过稀疏激活来扩展模型容量，但存储其完整参数在GPU显存中的开销仍然很高。现有的专家压缩方法通常通过剪枝、合并或替换来解决这一问题，且往往将专家池的构建与路由工作负载的分配耦合在一起。在本工作中，我们将专家压缩形式化为两个决策——构建专家池以及将原始专家的工作负载分配到该池——并证明在专家池固定之后可以单独优化分配问题。基于这一形式化，我们提出了ConMoE，它利用锚点覆盖构建紧凑的专家池，并通过从层重构界推导出的、以路由器为条件的函数性目标来优化分配，仅将参数接近性作为代理指标。ConMoE使用无标签的校准输入，并保持路由器和专家权重冻结。在专家池固定后，函数性分配……
tldr: ConMoE将MoE专家压缩解耦为“专家池构建”与“功能负载分配”两个独立步骤，利用锚点覆盖构建紧凑专家池，并通过基于层重构界推导的路由器条件函数性目标优化分配，在路由器和专家权重保持冻结的情况下实现高效压缩。
en_tdlr: ConMoE decouples MoE expert compression into expert pool construction and functional workload assignment, building a compact pool via Anchor Coverage and optimizing assignment through a router-conditioned functional objective derived from a layer reconstruction bound, while keeping the router and expert weights frozen.
